items.name: text
items.title: Text
items.description: Text in the theme's type scale: default, h1 to h4 (announced as headings), lead, large, small, muted and code. Inside a Button, Card or Badge it takes that container's colour.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Triggers an action. Variants default, secondary, outline, ghost, destructive, link and raised (a face that sinks into its base while pressed); sizes sm, default, lg and three square icon sizes, all with a 44 px touch area. A loading state blocks presses.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: Short status or metadata label. Solid, secondary and outline styles, plus success, warning and destructive statuses shown as a coloured dot or your own icon.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: A surface that groups related content: header with title, description and an action at the top right, content and footer.

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: A hairline between items or sections, horizontal or vertical, hidden from screen readers unless it means something.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: A round picture of a person with initials while it loads or when it fails, in three sizes, and a group that overlaps them.

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: A callout on the card surface, read as one element; default, success, warning and destructive tones colour its icon.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: A single-line text field in the theme: 44 px tall, a focus ring, and an error state from aria-invalid.

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: The platform's activity indicator in the theme's muted colour, announced as Loading.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: A placeholder shape that pulses on the native thread while content loads, and holds still with Reduce Motion.

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: A bar for a task with a known amount that springs to each value, or an indeterminate one; screen readers hear the value.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: An on/off control whose thumb springs across while the track fades to the primary colour, in two sizes with a 44 px touch area.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: A box to tick whose mark pops in with a spring, with an indeterminate dash and an error state.

items.name: segmented-control
items.title: Segmented Control
items.description: A switch between options of equal width with a thumb that springs to the active one; a radio group for screen readers that never goes empty.

items.name: rating
items.title: Rating
items.description: Stars for giving a score, tapped or adjusted by screen readers as one control, or for showing one read-only with fractional fills.
items.docs: Install the native module for your Expo SDK first: npx expo install react-native-svg

items.name: wave-rating
items.title: Wave Rating
items.description: The rating, animated: a finger sweeping the stars lifts them in a wave with a haptic tick per star and a tip showing the score, and letting go pops the chosen star. Same props and accessibility as rating.
items.docs: Install the native modules for your Expo SDK first: npx expo install react-native-gesture-handler react-native-reanimated react-native-worklets react-native-svg expo-haptics. The app needs a GestureHandlerRootView at its root.

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: Brief messages from toast() anywhere in the app, stacked at the top or bottom edge clear of the safe area: three at a time, announced to screen readers, paused while touched or in the background, and swiped away sideways or towards their edge.
items.docs: Install the native module for your Expo SDK first: npx expo install react-native-safe-area-context. Then render <Toaster /> once, as the last child of your root view inside SafeAreaProvider.

items.name: drawer
items.title: Drawer
items.description: A bottom sheet in a Modal: it springs up, follows a drag down to close, sits clear of the home indicator and the iOS keyboard, keeps screen readers inside, and closes with the back button, the escape gesture or the overlay.
items.docs: Install the native module for your Expo SDK first: npx expo install react-native-safe-area-context

items.name: empty-state
items.title: Empty State
items.description: What a screen shows when there is nothing yet: an icon, a heading, a line about what to do and actions, with or without a dashed border.
